#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    bool flag = true;
    int arr[40] = {0};
    int cntr = 0;
    while (m > 0) {
        arr[cntr++] = m % w;
        m = m / w;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= cntr; i++) {
        if (arr[i] != 0 && arr[i] != 1 && arr[i] != w && arr[i] != w - 1) {
            flag = false;
            break;
        } else {
            if (arr[i] == w || arr[i] == w - 1) {
                arr[i + 1]++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (flag)
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    else
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    return 0;
}
